picks.title: God Worship in Advaita Vedanta
picks.summary: In this episode, Rajesh and Narayanan discuss whether devotion and Advaita are truly contradictory. Drawing on Swami Sarvapriyananda, they explore how worship, meditation, and the experience of oneness can all be part of the same spiritual journey.https://youtu.be/5Dk4EIe-qyk?is=5TBdCXYqMpaMQyNh
picks.reason: A deep discussion on devotion and non-duality in Advaita Vedanta.

picks.title: Vivarta siddhānta: Uḷḷadu Nāṟpadu verse 1 & Guru Vācaka Kōvai verse 83
picks.summary:
In an online meeting with the Ramana Maharshi Foundation UK on 12th September 2026, Michael explains Vivarta siddhānta: Uḷḷadu Nāṟpadu verse 1 (https://sriramanateachings.org/blog/2017/10/ulladu-narpadu-tamil-text.html#un01and ) Guru Vācaka Kōvai verse 83 (https://sriramanateachings.org/gvk-translations.html#gvk83 ), and then answers questions on Bhagavan Ramana's teachings. 
This episode is available as a video on YouTube. A more compressed audio copy in Opus format can be downloaded from MediaFire. Michael's explanations on the original works of Bhagavan can be watched free of advertisements
picks.reason: Detailed exposition of Ramana Maharshi's teachings on nonduality and self-realization.

picks.title: Functioning of the Subtle Universe Within Us
picks.summary: In this episode, we’ll give a unique look at the subtle universe within us. Vedanta teaches that this inner realm contains the subtle forms of everything we experience. We’ll explore how the mind receives, processes, and projects these subtle forms as the physical world we perceive “out there.” We’ll also examine the connection between the Individual Mind and the Cosmic Mind through simple, everyday examples. Finally, you’ll have a clearer understanding of how the Subtle Universe functions and why it lies at the heart of our experience.We look forward to hear back from you!For questions or fee
picks.reason: Explains Vedanta concepts of subtle universe, mind, and cosmic connection clearly and deeply.

picks.title: 1821: Krishna Doesn't Need Your Zucchini Bread | But He Wants Your Love
picks.summary: The Bhagavad-gītā sings of Krishna as the Absolute Truth — complete in himself, independent and lacking nothing. He doesn't need anything we can offer him. And yet — he wants our love. Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that paradox through the narration of Krishna's entrance into Mathurā — and what two very different encounters reveal about the one thing that actually matters in our relationship with God. Srimad Bhagavatam 10.41.34-39  ******************************************************************** LOVE THE PODCAST? WE ARE COMMUNITY SUPPORTED AND WOULD LOVE FOR YOU TO JOIN! Go to https://ww
picks.reason: Explores Krishna's nature and the essence of loving devotion.

picks.title: S1E15 — Bringing Ganga to Earth | Ramayan – The Eternal Journey
picks.summary: Bhagiratha takes on a sacred mission: to bring the divine river Ganga down to Earth and liberate the sons of Sagara.Through years of intense austerity, Bhagiratha earns the blessings of Brahma and Shiva. But Ganga’s descent is so powerful that only Shiva can receive her safely. From Shiva’s matted locks, the river finally reaches the Earth and follows Bhagiratha toward the ashes of his ancestors.In this episode of Ramayan – The Eternal Journey, discover the devotion, perseverance, and divine intervention behind one of the Ramayan’s most enduring stories — the descent of Ganga.Presented by Drea
picks.reason: Narrates Bhagiratha's sacred mission with themes of devotion and liberation.

picks.showTitle: Be There Now, Hosted by Anasuya Weil and Hanuman Goleman
picks.title: Ep. 1 - Darshan with Maharaj-ji with Anasuya Weil and Parvati Markus
picks.summary: Welcome to Be There Now, a new podcast series sharing first-hand encounters with Maharaj-ji.In this first episode, host Anasuya Weil shares the special story of her own darshan with special guest Parvati Markus.In this inaugural episode of Be There Now, Anasuya is interviewed by Parvati on:How Anasuya met her guru, Neem Karoli Baba (Maharaj-ji)Ram Dass, Anasuya, and the blanket story How Maharaj-ji truly embodied service and the spirit of HanumanDarshan from Maharaj-ji during Anasuya’s pregnancy Attachment: Becoming ‘like a lotus above the water’ Communing with Maharaj-ji in the dreamspace“The
picks.reason: Shares direct experiences with Neem Karoli Baba, a Hindu guru, emphasizing devotion and service.

picks.showTitle: Chinmaya Mission - Gita, Upanishads and Ancient Knowledge
picks.title: What Lies Beyond Worldly Pleasure?| Essence of the Geeta | Episode 86
picks.summary: Swami Swaroopananda, Global Head of Chinmaya Mission, is a revered spiritual leader known for his clear, profound Vedanta teachings. His wisdom guides many towards self-discovery and inner peace, making complex concepts accessible and inspiring globally. In this series, Swamiji distills the learnings from the Bhagavad Geeta and explains it in a way that allows everyone to enjoy the essence of the Geeta.
picks.reason: Clear Vedanta teachings on self-discovery and essence of the Gita.
